cue.heading: American Electric Power Co. v. Connecticut (2011)
cue.quote: For it is an academic question whether, in the absence of the Clean Air Act and the EPA actions the Act authorizes, the plaintiffs could state a federal common-law claim for curtailment of greenhouse gas emissions because of their contribution to global warming.
